criteria.label: RELATED
similar: Roads, structures, and tower bases follow diagonal ground axes.
different: REFERENCE changes from a closer F01 crop to a much wider F02 landscape.
CANDIDATE preserves nearly identical strict-isometric framing across both frames.
REFERENCE F02 has a softer panoramic pitch than the tile-like CANDIDATE view.

evidence.observation: Both frames are oblique, but apparent scale, pitch, and visible world extent change substantially between F01 and F02.
F01 and F02 retain the same steep isometric camera, crop, and landmark placement.

criteria.label: RELATED
similar: Both show dark blue-gray winding water through industrial terrain.
Bridges cross the channel and visibly connect to both banks.
Water becomes more prominent in the second frame.
different: CANDIDATE F02 expands into a broad flooded basin with sharp, grid-aligned banks.
REFERENCE F02 retains a narrower natural channel with deeper terrain-cut banks.
CANDIDATE water has brighter directional streaks and stronger blue contrast.

evidence.observation: F02 shows a muted, naturally meandering channel with shaded canyon-like banks and a bridge near the lower middle.
F02 shows a greatly widened blue basin around the same two bridges, with angular banks and conspicuous surface streaks.
F01 contains the corresponding narrow channel before the visible expansion.

criteria.label: CLOSE
similar: Both use blackened metal, dark concrete, rocky soil, and restrained midtones.
Small amber windows and lamps punctuate the industrial structures.
Plants, pylons, roads, and terrain share a cohesive weathered treatment.
different: REFERENCE is more painterly and organically textured, especially in F02.
CANDIDATE has crisper sprite edges, stronger outlines, and more visibly tiled paving.
CANDIDATE floodwater is cooler and flatter than the muted REFERENCE water.

evidence.observation: Dense soot-dark terrain and metal facilities are unified by fine painterly texture and sparse amber illumination.
The same dark industrial palette is present, with sharper asset silhouettes and repeated concrete tile seams.

criteria.label: RELATED
similar: Both distinguish cyan energized routes from amber dashed routes.
Conductors run through repeated lattice towers across the map.
Major routes remain readable against the dark terrain.
different: CANDIDATE cyan conductors are much thicker, more numerous, and form broad loops.
REFERENCE routes are thinner and attach more consistently through tower tops.
CANDIDATE F02 mixes cyan routes with territory outlines and red overlays, reducing hierarchy.

evidence.observation: F01 presents thin cyan and amber routes with clear tower-by-tower progression and restrained route density.
F02 keeps slender amber and cyan corridors visually distinct across the river landscape.
Thick multi-strand cyan paths dominate both frames; F02 adds loops and colored parcel outlines around the towers.

criteria.label: RELATED
similar: Both pairs associate the alternate state with increased water prominence.
Industrial facilities, towers, and conductors remain present around the affected terrain.
The dark industrial visual language persists through the state presentation.
different: CANDIDATE clearly preserves one world and enlarges its central channel between frames.
REFERENCE frames show different framing, terrain, facilities, and route layouts, weakening direct world continuity.
CANDIDATE flood inundation is broader and more explicit than the natural river emphasis in REFERENCE F02.

evidence.observation: F01 and F02 share an industrial river theme, but landmark layout and world framing do not visibly persist between them.
The same bridges, plants, towers, roads, and crop persist while the narrow F01 channel becomes a large F02 flooded basin.
